description: Image Description: A pigeon is perched on a metal railing in the foreground, facing to the right. The bird has a dark gray plumage with iridescent hints on its neck and wings, and bright orange-red feet gripping the railing. Its head is slightly tilted, and its beak is pointed and dark. The background features a European-style building with cream-colored walls, white shutters on the windows, and a series of dormer windows on the roofline. The sunlight casts soft shadows
